tagline: Schedule Zoom design reviews from Figma milestones and share feedback automatically
metaTitle: Zoom + Figma Integration: Design Review Scheduling
metaDescription: Review designs at the right moment. GAIA books a Zoom design review at each Figma milestone and posts feedback as comments. See the setup steps.
intro:
Design reviews happen in Zoom, but the designs live in Figma — and the feedback captured in the meeting rarely makes it back to the file in a timely way. Designers end up reconciling handwritten notes with verbal comments from a recording they have to scrub through.

GAIA connects the two so design review meetings are scheduled automatically when milestones are reached, and feedback from the call is posted as Figma comments before the designer's next work session. Design and review stay tightly coupled.

useCases.title: Schedule Zoom reviews when Figma milestones are reached
useCases.description: When a file is marked ready for review, GAIA schedules a meeting with the relevant stakeholders. The invite includes a direct link to the Figma file.

useCases.title: Post review feedback as Figma comments
useCases.description: After a design review call, GAIA parses the meeting notes for feedback items and posts them as comments on the relevant frames. Designers have structured feedback without re-watching the recording.

useCases.title: Notify the design team of the meeting recording
useCases.description: When a design review recording is ready, GAIA posts the Zoom link as a file comment. Anyone who missed the call can watch the review in the context of the file being discussed.

useCases.title: Create follow-up Zoom sessions for unresolved comments
useCases.description: GAIA monitors for comments that remain unresolved after a review and schedules a quick follow-up session with the designer and reviewer. No action item gets forgotten between design cycles.

howItWorks.step: Connect Zoom and Figma to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA with your Zoom account and Figma workspace. Specify which projects and status labels should trigger meeting scheduling.

howItWorks.step: Define review triggers and feedback routing
howItWorks.description: Set which milestone or status change schedules a review, and configure how GAIA formats and posts meeting feedback back to the file.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates your design review cycle
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for milestone changes, schedules calls, and closes the loop by returning feedback to the file. Design reviews happen on time with complete documentation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA post feedback to specific frames rather than the whole file?
faqs.answer: Yes. If the meeting notes reference specific frame names or component names, GAIA attempts to match them to frames and post comments at the frame level rather than the file level.

faqs.question: Who gets invited to the Zoom design review automatically?
faqs.answer: GAIA invites the file's editors and any stakeholders you configure in GAIA's review settings. You can also specify a fixed reviewer list per project.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with Figma's branching feature?
faqs.answer: GAIA tracks reviews at the file level. If you use branches, configure the milestone status on the branch file and GAIA will schedule the review for that branch's reviewers.
